beat: Sunday restaurant: Sharmi and Raj enter the scene

lines.original: Sunday morning Dhika was back in her normal state..... She had no plans to paint today and she was double sure that Chotu will not turn up today.... she doubted even if Chotu will come here again....
lines.local: Sunday morning Dhika phir normal thi. Painting ka plan nahi tha aur use yakeen tha Chotu nahi aayega; use toh shak tha ki woh kabhi dobara ghar bhi aayega ya nahi.

lines.original: It was a pretty usual sunday... with all cleaning and cooking.... but by evening John told Dhika to get ready, that he wanted to take Dhika and Pappu for a nice dinner.... but Pappu on the other hand wanted to go to the park with aunty... so, they left Pappu with aunty and went to the restaurant....
lines.local: Sunday saaf-safai aur cooking mein beeta. Shaam ko John ne Dhika aur Pappu ko dinner par le jaane ko kaha, par Pappu Aunty ke saath park jaana chahta tha; use Aunty ke saath chhodkar dono restaurant gaye.

lines.original: It was a chilly evening and little dark, earlier than usual..... with cresent moon peeking behind the clouds.... The wind was a little more, blowing Dhika's free hairs like waves....
lines.local: Thandi shaam thi, aam se jaldi andhera ho raha tha; baadalon ke peeche crescent moon jhaank raha tha aur tez hawa Dhika ke khule baalon ko lehra rahi thi.

lines.original: Dhika was beautifully dressed in a salwar, but to John's surprise...she did not wear a shawl, not that the dress needed one.... John made a note of it as soon as they left their home and when they reached the restaurant and waiting to get in, he saw a lot of heads turning towards Dhika.
lines.local: Dhika sundar salwar mein thi, lekin John ne notice kiya ki usne shawl nahi liya—waise dress ko uski zaroorat bhi nahi thi. Ghar se nikalte hi yeh baat uske dhyan mein aayi; restaurant ke bahar log Dhika ko mud-mudkar dekh rahe the.

lines.original: John and Dhika were still waiting to get into the restaurant, Dhika laughing and giggling at something John was telling her, while she got a tap in her shoulders.....
lines.local: Restaurant mein entry ka wait karte hue Dhika John ki baat par hans rahi thi ki uske kandhe par kisi ne tap kiya.

lines.original: Sharmi: Oi.....
lines.local: Sharmi: Oi!

lines.original: Dhika: hey.....fancy looking you here..... weekend date ? John you remember Sharmi..... and this is.....
lines.local: Dhika: Arre, tum yahan! Weekend date? John, Sharmi yaad hai? Aur yeh…

lines.original: Sharmi: Raj.... my husband....(  Sharmi completed Dhika's sentence) hi John.... she winked at John...
lines.local: Sharmi ne Dhika ki baat poori ki: Raj, mera husband! Hi John… aur John ko wink kiya.

lines.original: John shook hands with Raj and they both greeted each other....
lines.local: John ne Raj se handshake kiya aur dono ne greeting ki.

lines.original: John remembered Sharmi from both his marriage and from quite a few times Dhika had said about her naughtness from work, together in college... John had a fair idea that sharmi was a naughty girl.... Raj on the other hand looked pleasant and polite....
lines.local: John ko Sharmi apni shaadi se aur Dhika ke college/work ke naughty kisse sunne se yaad thi. Uske nature ka andaaza tha; Raj pleasant aur polite laga.

lines.original: Unlike Dhika.... Shami was dressed to kill. She wasn't as gorgeous as Dhika but she was hot in her own ways... John scanned Sharmi's attire.. she was wearing a sleeveless blue mini dress with huge open back.... it was a single piece of cloth that ended mid thighs and she was wearing black liners around her eyes which looked seductive....
lines.local: Dhika se alag Sharmi bahut bold outfit mein thi. John ne uska sleeveless blue mini dress dekha: bada open back, mid-thigh hem aur aankhon ka seductive black liner. Woh apne tareeke se hot thi.

lines.original: Dhika noticed John scanning Sharmi...while failing to see Raj doing the same to her.....
lines.local: Dhika ne John ko Sharmi ko scan karte dekha, lekin Raj bhi Dhika ko usi tarah dekh raha tha—yeh usne nahi dekha.

lines.original: Raj and Sharmi were also waiting to get their table in the same restaurant.... coincidentally...
lines.local: Ittefaq se Raj aur Sharmi bhi usi restaurant mein table ka wait kar rahe the.

lines.original: John: being polite and charming..... hey, why don't we join our tables and have dinner together....
lines.local: John ne polite aur charming andaaz mein kaha: Kyun na hum saath table lekar dinner karein?

lines.original: Sharmi: thats a wonderful idea... she commented before Dhika can.....
lines.local: Dhika se pehle Sharmi bol padi: Bahut accha idea hai!

lines.original: Raj: No... let's not disturb them dear.....
lines.local: Raj: Nahi dear, inhe disturb nahi karna chahiye.

lines.original: Dhika: no.... nothing like that...please join us...
lines.local: Dhika: Arre nahi, aisi baat nahi. Please hamare saath aaiye.

lines.original: Sharmi: smiling at her husband.... common...it will be fun...
lines.local: Sharmi apne husband ko muskuraakar: Chalo na, maza aayega.

lines.original: Finally Raj agreed and all 4 got into the restaurant..... John sat with Dhika on his right and Raj took the seat to the left of John....because Sharmi readily grabbed the seat opposite to John.... Raj noticed this and smiled at his wife....
lines.local: Aakhir Raj maan gaya. Chaaron restaurant mein gaye. John ke right Dhika aur left Raj baithe, kyunki Sharmi ne turant John ke saamne ki seat le li thi. Raj ne yeh notice karke wife ko dekhkar smile ki.

lines.original: Sharmi was leaning a lot and from John's vantage point, he could see a cute cleavage peeking from Sharmi's chest.... Not that John made an effort to see, but it was just lying there.... for feasting.....
lines.local: Sharmi baar-baar jhuk rahi thi; John ke angle se uski cleavage jhalak rahi thi. John jaanboojhkar dekhne ki koshish nahi kar raha tha, lekin woh seedhe saamne nazar aa rahi thi.
